answer: A willow bond blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a 70-credit willow bond and files a willow proof. Five neighbors each stake 8 credits and post a velvet receipt on the ledge board, each velvet receipt for one newcomer. Auditors replay the ledge: a neighbor vouching twice, or two newcomers sharing one funding key, burns the rented-neighbor ring. K-th costs 110+10(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 5,105,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 110 once.
